lines: Devinjit Singh may sell up to ₹0.91 crore in the offer, if all offered shares are sold.
Shares unlocked on 9 Sep 2026, 66 days ago; the trigger is recent, and the proceeds are in hand.
Their retained stake is an estimate of ₹2.13 crore at offer price, after selling 6,750 shares.
Average cost of acquisition is unknown, so gain cannot be assessed; identity verified in seller table, holdings in one section only.
